## API Authentication

Single Responsibility: validate that BUDGETFLOW_BASE_URL and BUDGETFLOW_SERVICE_API_KEY are configured as n8n environment variables, and fail fast with a clear error if not.

Most workflows in 03-budgetflow-api-client reference $env.BUDGETFLOW_BASE_URL / $env.BUDGETFLOW_SERVICE_API_KEY directly in their HTTP Request nodes (simplest, no extra hop). Call this workflow first via Execute Workflow if you want an explicit preflight check with a clear error message instead of a generic HTTP 401 further downstream.

Generate a key: sign in to BudgetFlow, POST /api/settings/service-api-key with {name, scopes}. Store the returned key as the BUDGETFLOW_SERVICE_API_KEY environment variable in n8n (Settings > Environments, or .env for self-hosted).
